Name: Bald Eagle
Description: With a wingspan over six feet, the bald eagle soars on rising air with barely a wingbeat, scanning lakes and rivers for fish. Once nearly lost to pesticides, it has recovered dramatically, a conservation comeback that mirrors its name: a symbol of strength renewed.
CreationReflection: Eagles do not flap their way higher; they ride the wind. Waiting on the Lord is like that. Strength comes not from striving but from trusting the lift God provides.
Habitat: Lakes, rivers, and coasts across North America.
